Shri T.r. Baalu and Shri A. Raja ceased to be Ministers in the Council of Ministers.
Shri Dilip Singh Judev ceased to be Minister of State in the Council of Ministers.
Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways
Appointment of Sh. K.R. Kishore, IAS (AP:81) as Chairman of the Visakhapatnam Port Trust.
Appointment of Shri Shrish M. Gupte, Senior Advocate as Additional Solicitor General of India in the Bombay High Court.
Ministry of Communications and Information Technology
Shri R.U.S. Prasad vacated the office of Member of the Telecom Disputes Settlement and Appellate on 28th September, 2003.
Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways
Appointment of Sh. Subrat Tripathi, IRTS(1987), Deputy Chairman, Paradip Port Trust as the acting Chairman of the trust.
Re-appointment of Shri K.K. Sud, Senior Advocate as Additional Solicitor General of India for Delhi High Court.
The President of India appoints Smt. Mamata Banerjee and Shri Gingee N. Ramachandran as the members of the Council of Ministers.
Appointment of Shri L. Nageswara Rao, Senior Advocate as Additional Solicitor General of India in the Supreme Court of India.
Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways
Extension of the tenure of Shri S.R. Rao, IAS(GJ:78) Chairman, Visakhapatnam Port Trust.
Shri Ananth Kumar ceased to be Minister in the Council of Ministers.
The list of persons ceased to be Ministers in the Council of Ministers.
President appoints certain persons as the members of the Council of Ministers.
Appointment of Shri Surendra Kumar Kapur, Senior Advocate as Additional Solicitor General of India, Calcutta High Court.
Appointment of Shri V.T. Gopalan, Senior Advocate as Additional Solicitor General of India, Chennai.
Shri Shanta Kumar ceased to be Minister in the Council of Ministers.
Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways
Appointment of Smt. Neera Saggi, IAS (WB:80), Deputy Chairman of Jawaharlal Nehru Port Trust as the Acting Chairperson of the trust.
Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways
Appointment of Sh. R.R. Sinha, IAS (MH:76), Deputy Chairman of the Mumbai Port Trust as Acting Chairman, Mumbai Port Trust.
Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways
The extension of the tenure of Sh. R.R. Sinha, IAS (MH:76), Deputy Chairman of the Mumbai Port Trust.
Ministry of Communications and Information Technology
Shri M.S. Verma shall vacate the office of Chairperson of the Telecom Regulatory Authority of India on 22nd March, 2003.
Ministry of Communications and Information Technology
Prof. V.S. Raju shall vacate the office of part-time Member of the Telecom Regulatory Authority of India.
Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways
Appointment of Sh. R. B. Budhiraja, IAS (MH:68) as the Chairman of Jawaharlal Nehru Port Trust.
Appointment of certain persons to be the members of the Council of Ministers w.e.f 29th January, 2003.
Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways
Appointment of Sh. Subrat Tripathi, IRTS(1987) as Deputy Chairman of the Paradip Port Trust for a period of five years.
Ministry of Communications and Information Technology
Shri R.R.N. Prasad shall vacate the office of whole-time Member of the Telecom Regulatory Authority of India.
Shri Omar Abdullah ceased to be Minister of State in the Council of Ministers with effect from 23rd December, 2002.
